purpose: Navigation registry for the belief atlas. Political, religious, comparative and project-defined systems remain addressable without collapsing them into one taxonomy.

layers.name: Political ideologies
layers.coordinate_system: economic organization × state authority × social-cultural openness

layers.name: Religious emergence and foundation
layers.coordinate_system: field → substrate → foundation → seed → sprout → formation → trunk → branches

layers.name: Comparative religious library
layers.coordinate_system: text × concept × place × practice × history × relationship

layers.name: Potatoism project layer
layers.coordinate_system: birth → growth → symbolic architecture → continuing development

navigation_policy: Every entry has a stable slug and can resolve to a canonical record. Religious records can resolve outward to their foundation, texts, concepts, places, institutions, branches and comparative relationships.
research_principles: attach primary and scholarly sources to definitions
avoid treating labels as descriptions of every adherent
make analytical coordinates explicit rather than presenting them as objective measurements
keep project-symbolic material visibly distinct from empirical historical evidence
